title: truth-pack.v1
description: The facts a written piece may state. An article run takes one with its brief; scripts/studio_claims.py matches every figure, unit, name and date of a draft to an entry here, and anything it cannot match is unsupported. The pack is the user's: the studio never adds an entry. scripts/studio_claims.py reads THIS file for the shape through the validator of scripts/studio_verdict.py, so only the keywords that validator implements are used here; the rule a schema cannot say (entry ids are unique: entry_id_twice) is in studio_claims.pack_problems.

subject.description: What the pack is about, in a few words.

id.description: The id a claim list and a ruling name this entry by.

fact.description: The fact as stated, in one or two sentences.

figures.description: Every figure of the fact, each with its unit. A draft's figure matches when the value is equal, sign included, and the unit is the same (a figure written with no unit matches only an entry figure with no unit). Where a product has two figures in one unit, in one entry or in two, each stands under a condition: the runner matches such a figure only when the statement puts it beside a word that the `fact` writes in that figure's clause and not in the other's (`at low load` against `at full load`), and otherwise the statement waits for a ruling. So write the fact with words of its own beside each figure.

value.description: The number as digits. A value below nought starts with a minus: `-5`.

names.description: The product, model and other proper names the fact is about, as they are written. The runner matches a figure of this entry only for a statement that says one of these names, and every name the statement says must be listed here. Write every spelling of a product on each of its entries. A fact that several products share is one entry that names all of them. An entry with no name supports no statement by itself: it can only be named in a ruling.

date.description: When the fact holds or was measured: a year, a month and year, or a full date.

source.description: Where the fact comes from. The hand-over prints it beside every claim the entry supports.
